RATIONALE: This nocturnal owl's dark, barred plumage perfectly captures the shadowy colors and mystery associated with Baleful Strix. Its silent flight and precise predatory strikes embody deathtouch, while its keen senses and intelligence reflect the card's ability to draw knowledge upon entering.
